statement: Every small filtered diagram with a uniform finite bound m on stage arrows is isomorphic in Ind(Cat_hot) to a constant category with at most m arrows.
notes: Finite element category gives a retract of a stage; an eventually periodic endofunctor has a strictly idempotent power representing the same homotopy-idempotent. Finite-test invariance is evaluated by B.8; no further global locality implication is asserted.
